newsitem.title: USA: K-III Communications unit names new CEO. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT 21/10]
newsitem.headline: K-III Communications unit names new CEO. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT 21/10]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear that the new CEO is for its unit, not the parent company)
K-III Communications Corp said Friday that its unit Channel One Network has named its chief operating officer David Tanzer to succeed Ed Winter as president and chief executive.
Winter will fill the newly created position of company chairman, company spokesman David Adler said.

K-III said Winter helped found the Channel One Network, which provides satellite educational programming, and Tanzer led the 1994 acquisition of Channel One from Whittle Communications, which is 25 percent owned by Philips Electronics NV.
